plan.major: Dental Hygiene - AAS to BS Dental Hygiene Online Completion
plan.notes: Source: UAFS 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog program page (poid=1351). TRACK CHOICE: the catalog publishes two suggested plans (Spring admission: Spring 14 / Summer 3 / Fall 15; Fall admission: Fall 15 / Spring 14 / Summer 3); this seed follows the FALL-admission track in catalog order. For students holding an associate degree in dental hygiene from a CODA-accredited program with current unencumbered dental hygiene license. CATALOG TOTAL NOTE: the catalog states 120 total hours = 88 pre-program requirement hours (English Composition 6, Speech 3, Mathematics 3, Lab Science 16, Social Sciences 6, Computer requirement 2, dental hygiene credit for licensure held in escrow 52) + 32 sequenced hours; pre-program requirements are recorded in external_prereqs, not as a term. Per collection rule total_credits = sequenced sum = 32. Lab science 16 hrs: BIOL 24003/24001, BIOL 24103/24101, BIOL 20003/20001, CHEM 10003/10001 required; social sciences PSYC 11003 and SOCI 10103 required. Grade C or better in all courses. Transcribed 2026-10-01 from a live-browser harvest of the official catalog. program_type 'completion': AAS-to-BS online completion; requires associate degree in dental hygiene.
